generation.approval_note: Fresh ImageGen smoke-test master: complete circle; 58 is first read and F2 second; exact secondary labels pass; broad black/charcoal/gray/ivory fields and abstract rehouse motifs pass. Re-review before public branding use.

anchor_system_consequences.effect: The radial searchlight wedge passes behind the lower edge of 58 and terminates at the optical-swirl focal point, making the numeral part of the negative-space boundary.
The modular cinema-registration grid carries the wedge-and-swirl cadence into the segmented outer chassis.

design_review.structural_thesis: A searchlight wedge crosses the dominant 58, drives the optical swirl field, and resolves into the segmented rehoused chassis at the perimeter.
design_review.finish_target_note: The approved finish floor is layered cinematic motion with coherent line rhythm, integrated type counterforms, and intentional mechanical framing rather than decorative density.
design_review.reviewer_note: The qualified rehoused-cinema anchor owns the searchlight wedge, optical swirl field, and segmented chassis; a lens without that documented family association would require a different field structure.
